problems.what: The Dojebon release risk in 154 is understated, and its fix is listed as optional and "zero code". The "~20 u spare" figure assumes the east probe starts at the spawn. In the code, calibration probes the v axis first (up, then down), and judges each probe from where the previous one left him. The down RUN probe is therefore allowed once 'up' has moved him north; the map says the 31-fps down probe is refused. So the east probe can start up to ~120 u south of the spawn. There the 3600 circle's edge is only ~224-300 u east, inside a 31-fps 4-frame run probe's 300-u reach. At 60 fps, one hitch adds ~240 u to a 180-u probe. Once released, Dojebon (walk speed 58) patrols indices 4-13 with no wait, head-on along the west arm (x -1600) and the stair top that step 0 walks.

Patrol direction: ip282-ip305; walks without waits: ip316-ip474. session.py:2004-2008 and 2020-2058: v before h, up before down, each probe judged at the current position. tickrate.py:242-248: reach = 60*(ticks_most+1), i.e. 300 u at ~31 fps, 180-240 at 60. tickrate.py:72-77: a 120-ms hitch catches up 4 ticks, in about 1 in-control window in 25.
